title: Break Shot
summary: Play pool with the dot product: send the cue ball off at a right angle, with a set energy, and with a set shadow on the rail.
subject: mathematics
concepts: The dot product of two vectors
Perpendicular vectors and the zero dot product
Finding an unknown component from a dot product
Projection of a vector on another
learningOutcome: The student can compute a dot product from components, use a zero dot product to find a perpendicular vector, and find the projection of a vector on a direction.

levels.title: Right angle
levels.adds: Baseline: two vectors are perpendicular exactly when a·b = a₁b₁ + a₂b₂ = 0 (Ex 10.3 Q5, Q10 to Q12, Q17; Example 12).
hints: Write the dot product with the unknown λ in it.
Solve the one equation for λ.

levels.title: A set energy
levels.adds: New: the dot product is a number, and a given value gives a linear equation in the unknown component (Ex 10.3 Q1 to Q4; Examples 13, 14).
hints: Set the sum equal to the number wanted.
Solve for λ: it is a straight equation.

levels.title: The shadow
levels.adds: New: the projection of r on u is (r·u)/|u|, and it is negative when r points back (Ex 10.3 Q3, Q4; Example 16).
hints: Compute the dot product r·u with λ in it.
Divide by |u| and set it equal to the length wanted.

misconceptions: A dot product is a vector
Perpendicular vectors have a dot product of 1
